items.speaker: God
items.quote: Let there be light
items.verseText: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

items.speaker: God
items.quote: Let us make man in our image
items.verseText: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

items.speaker: God
items.quote: I do set my bow in the cloud
items.verseText: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

items.speaker: God
items.quote: I AM THAT I AM
items.verseText: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.

items.speaker: God
items.quote: Thou shalt have no other gods before me
items.verseText: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

items.speaker: God
items.quote: Fear not: for I have redeemed thee
items.verseText: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

items.speaker: God
items.quote: It is not good that the man should be alone
items.verseText: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.

items.speaker: Cain
items.quote: Am I my brother's keeper
items.verseText: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother’s keeper?

items.speaker: Abraham
items.quote: God will provide himself a lamb
items.verseText: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

items.speaker: Isaac
items.quote: hast thou not reserved a blessing for me
items.verseText: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?

items.speaker: Jacob
items.quote: I will not let thee go, except thou bless me
items.verseText: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

items.speaker: Joseph
items.quote: Fear not: for am I in the place of God
items.verseText: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?

items.speaker: Moses
items.quote: Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh
items.verseText: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?

items.speaker: Moses
items.quote: The LORD is my strength and song
items.verseText: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

items.speaker: Pharaoh
items.quote: Who is the LORD, that I should obey his voice
items.verseText: And Pharaoh said, Who is the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the LORD, neither will I let Israel go.

items.speaker: Balaam
items.quote: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold
items.verseText: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.

items.speaker: Joshua
items.quote: Be strong and of a good courage
items.verseText: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

items.speaker: Joshua
items.quote: as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD
items.verseText: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

items.speaker: Samson
items.quote: O Lord GOD, remember me, I pray thee
items.verseText: And Samson called unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.

items.speaker: Ruth
items.quote: whither thou goest, I will go
items.verseText: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

items.speaker: Naomi
items.quote: call me not Naomi, call me Mara
items.verseText: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.

items.speaker: Samuel
items.quote: Speak; for thy servant heareth
items.verseText: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.

items.speaker: Saul
items.quote: I have sinned
items.verseText: And Saul said unto Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed the commandment of the LORD, and thy words: because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.

items.speaker: David
items.quote: I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts
items.verseText: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.

items.speaker: David
items.quote: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness
items.verseText: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

items.speaker: David
items.quote: I have sinned against the LORD
items.verseText: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the LORD. And Nathan said unto David, The LORD also hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.

items.speaker: Solomon
items.quote: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart
items.verseText: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?

items.speaker: Elijah
items.quote: It is enough; now, O LORD, take away my life
items.verseText: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O LORD, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.

items.speaker: Elisha
items.quote: let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me
items.verseText: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.

items.speaker: Job
items.quote: The LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away
items.verseText: And said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.

items.speaker: Job
items.quote: I know that my redeemer liveth
items.verseText: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

items.speaker: Isaiah
items.quote: Here am I; send me
items.verseText: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.

items.speaker: Isaiah
items.quote: Woe is me! for I am undone
items.verseText: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts.

items.speaker: Jeremiah
items.quote: Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak
items.verseText: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.

items.speaker: Jonah
items.quote: Salvation is of the LORD
items.verseText: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the LORD.

items.speaker: Daniel
items.quote: our God whom we serve is able to deliver us
items.verseText: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.

items.speaker: Esther
items.quote: if I perish, I perish
items.verseText: Go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also and my maidens will fast likewise; and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish.

items.speaker: Mary
items.quote: be it unto me according to thy word
items.verseText: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

items.speaker: Mary
items.quote: My soul doth magnify the Lord
items.verseText: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,

items.speaker: Zacharias
items.quote: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel
items.verseText: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,

items.speaker: John the Baptist
items.quote: I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness
items.verseText: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.

items.speaker: John the Baptist
items.quote: Behold the Lamb of God
items.verseText: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Man shall not live by bread alone
items.verseText: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Ye are the light of the world
items.verseText: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden
items.verseText: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart
items.verseText: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: not as I will, but as thou wilt
items.verseText: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: I am the bread of life
items.verseText: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: I am the light of the world
items.verseText: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free
items.verseText: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: I am the good shepherd
items.verseText: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: I am the resurrection, and the life
items.verseText: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: I am the way, the truth, and the life
items.verseText: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Peace I leave with you
items.verseText: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Greater love hath no man than this
items.verseText: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do
items.verseText: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit
items.verseText: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me
items.verseText: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: It is finished
items.verseText: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Suffer the little children to come unto me
items.verseText: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Our Father which art in heaven
items.verseText: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: But whom say ye that I am
items.verseText: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?

items.speaker: Peter
items.quote: Lord, save me
items.verseText: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.

items.speaker: Peter
items.quote: Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God
items.verseText: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

items.speaker: Peter
items.quote: Thou hast the words of eternal life
items.verseText: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

items.speaker: Peter
items.quote: Silver and gold have I none
items.verseText: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.

items.speaker: Peter
items.quote: We ought to obey God rather than men
items.verseText: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.

items.speaker: Thomas
items.quote: Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails
items.verseText: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.

items.speaker: Philip
items.quote: Lord, shew us the Father
items.verseText: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

items.speaker: Nathanael
items.quote: Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth
items.verseText: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.

items.speaker: Martha
items.quote: Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ
items.verseText: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

items.speaker: Zacchaeus
items.quote: the half of my goods I give to the poor
items.verseText: And Zacchæus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

items.speaker: The Samaritan woman
items.quote: Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not
items.verseText: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

items.speaker: Bartimaeus
items.quote: Lord, that I might receive my sight
items.verseText: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.

items.speaker: Pilate
items.quote: What I have written I have written
items.verseText: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

items.speaker: Paul
items.quote: Lord, what wilt thou have me to do
items.verseText: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.

items.speaker: Paul
items.quote: Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ
items.verseText: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

items.speaker: Paul
items.quote: It is more blessed to give than to receive
items.verseText: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

items.speaker: Paul
items.quote: I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ
items.verseText: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

items.speaker: Paul
items.quote: For to me to live is Christ
items.verseText: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

items.speaker: Paul
items.quote: I have fought a good fight
items.verseText: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

items.speaker: Paul
items.quote: I am crucified with Christ
items.verseText: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

items.speaker: Stephen
items.quote: Lord Jesus, receive my spirit
items.verseText: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

items.speaker: Stephen
items.quote: Lord, lay not this sin to their charge
items.verseText: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

items.speaker: Ananias
items.quote: Lord, I have heard by many of this man
items.verseText: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:

items.speaker: Lydia
items.quote: If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord
items.verseText: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.

items.speaker: Thomas
items.quote: My Lord and my God
items.verseText: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another
items.verseText: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Let not your heart be troubled
items.verseText: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations
items.verseText: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Go, and do thou likewise
items.verseText: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Love your enemies, bless them that curse you
items.verseText: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: I am the vine, ye are the branches
items.verseText: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Blessed are the peacemakers
items.verseText: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Ye are the salt of the earth
items.verseText: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Take therefore no thought for the morrow
items.verseText: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Ask, and it shall be given you
items.verseText: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: They that be whole need not a physician
items.verseText: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Suffer little children, and forbid them not
items.verseText: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners
items.verseText: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Ye must be born again
items.verseText: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: God is a Spirit
items.verseText: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: That ye love one another, as I have loved you
items.verseText: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: In the world ye shall have tribulation
items.verseText: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Surely I come quickly
items.verseText: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

items.speaker: Jesus
items.quote: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock
items.verseText: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

items.speaker: John the Baptist
items.quote: Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand
items.verseText: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

items.speaker: Paul
items.quote: I am persuaded
items.verseText: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,

items.speaker: Paul
items.quote: I can do all things through Christ
items.verseText: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

items.speaker: Paul
items.quote: Rejoice in the Lord alway
items.verseText: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

items.speaker: Agrippa
items.quote: Almost thou persuadest me
items.verseText: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.

items.speaker: Elijah
items.quote: How long halt ye between two opinions
items.verseText: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.

items.speaker: Jonah
items.quote: I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the LORD
items.verseText: And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the LORD, and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice.

items.speaker: Job
items.quote: Naked came I out of my mother's womb
items.verseText: And said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.

items.speaker: Job
items.quote: Shall we receive good at the hand of God
items.verseText: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.

items.speaker: David
items.quote: The LORD is my shepherd
items.verseText: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

items.speaker: Ruth
items.quote: Thy people shall be my people
items.verseText: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

items.speaker: Gideon
items.quote: The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon
items.verseText: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.

items.speaker: Samson
items.quote: With the jawbone of an ass
items.verseText: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.

items.speaker: Jephthah
items.quote: I have opened my mouth unto the LORD
items.verseText: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD, and I cannot go back.

items.speaker: Abraham
items.quote: I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord
items.verseText: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:

items.speaker: Joseph
items.quote: God did send me before you to preserve life
items.verseText: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

items.speaker: Esau
items.quote: Hast thou but one blessing
items.verseText: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

items.speaker: Rebekah
items.quote: why am I thus
items.verseText: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of the LORD.

items.speaker: Hagar
items.quote: Thou God seest me
items.verseText: And she called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?

items.speaker: Sarah
items.quote: Shall I have pleasure, my lord being old
items.verseText: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?

items.speaker: Peter
items.quote: Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee
items.verseText: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.

items.speaker: Thomas
items.quote: Let us also go, that we may die with him
items.verseText: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.

items.speaker: Caiaphas
items.quote: He hath spoken blasphemy
items.verseText: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.

items.speaker: Pilate
items.quote: I am innocent of the blood of this just person
items.verseText: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.

items.speaker: Mary
items.quote: all generations shall call me blessed
items.verseText: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

items.speaker: Elizabeth
items.quote: the mother of my Lord should come to me
items.verseText: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
